description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides mechanisms for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration functionalities. It includes nested classes, methods for buffer operations, and synchronization primitives, indicating its role in inter-process data sharing and buffer control.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared cyclic buffer management across process boundaries, with methods for locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration, including nested Cursor class for position management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A helper class for managing read positions within the cyclic buffer, providing peek and tail calculation functionalities.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(const string& fileName, const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with a filename, mode, size, and overwrite flag.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer(Core::DataElementFile& buffer, const bool initiator, const uint32_t offset, const uint32_t bufferSize, const bool overwrite)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cyclic buffer with an existing data element file, initiator flag, offset, size, and overwrite flag.

methods.name: ~CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup of the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available in the buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting until data is present.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Reads data non-destructively from the buffer without advancing the tail pointer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads and consumes data from the buffer, advancing the tail pointer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head pointer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing, moving the head pointer accordingly.
